summary: The bad() method opens an InputStreamReader/BufferedReader on System.in but never closes them, leaking the resource (CWE-772) on every invocation. I added a finally block that closes the BufferedReader (which chains to the underlying InputStreamReader), wrapping the close in its own try/catch so a close-time IOException is logged rather than propagated. Reading and echoing the line still works exactly as before for valid input.
